title: Locked-Rate Credit for Comfort Club Members with an Active Protection Contract
content:
A Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements member holding an active Harbison protection contract receives a credit on the locked rate of a reinstated term. The contract's tier is read from the member's active contract under Harbison Protection Contracts.

**Protection credit rule.** A member holding an active Harbison 10-Year Parts & Labor Protection, Harbison 12-Year Total Protection or Harbison 12-Year Total Protection Plus contract receives the long-protection credit of **6.00 USD**. A member holding an active protection contract of any other tier receives the other-protection credit of **3.00 USD**. A member with no active protection contract receives none.

**Questions and answers**

*The member holds an active Harbison 12-Year Total Protection Plus contract. What is the credit?* 6.00.

*The member holds an active contract of a tier not named above.* 3.00.

*The member's only protection contract is no longer active.* No credit; only an active contract counts.
